<a href="https://gitee.com/omniai/omniinfer/tree/release_v0.6.0/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/omniai/omniinfer/tree/release_v0.6.0/</a><br>
<a href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/tree/v0.9.0" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/tree/v0.9.0</a><br>
<a href="https://ai.gitcode.com/ascend-tribe/openPangu-Embedded-7B-V1.1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://ai.gitcode.com/ascend-tribe/openPangu-Embedded-7B-V1.1</a></p>
<h3 id="整体框架图和pangu7b模型图">整体框架图和pangu7b模型图</h3>
<p><img alt="vllm框架" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2257481/202512/2257481-20251208221524075-909452138.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="1-llmengine---核心引擎">1 LLMEngine - 核心引擎</h3>
<p>位置: vllm/engine/llm_engine.py</p>
<p>主要职责:</p>
<ul>
<li>请求处理和生命周期管理</li>
<li>调度协调和输出管理</li>
<li>多步迭代处理</li>
<li>与tokenizer和detokenizer集成</li>
</ul>
<p>关键特性:</p>
<pre><code>class LLMEngine:
    def __init__(self, model_config: ModelConfig, 
                 cache_config: CacheConfig,
                 parallel_config: ParallelConfig,
                 scheduler_config: SchedulerConfig,
                 device_config: DeviceConfig,
                 lora_config: LoRAConfig,
                 vision_language_config: VisionLanguageConfig,
                 speculative_config: SpeculativeConfig,
                 decoding_config: DecodingConfig,
                 observability_config: ObservabilityConfig,
                 prompt_adapter_config: PromptAdapterConfig,
                 executor_class: Type[ExecutorBase]):
</code></pre>
<p>核心方法:</p>
<ul>
<li>add_request(): 添加新请求</li>
<li>step(): 执行一个推理步骤</li>
<li>abort_request(): 中断请求</li>
<li>has_unfinished_requests(): 检查未完成请求</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2-scheduler---调度器">2 Scheduler - 调度器</h3>
<p>位置: vllm/core/scheduler.py</p>
<p>主要职责:</p>
<ul>
<li>实现连续批处理(Continuous Batching)</li>
<li>内存感知的请求调度</li>
<li>优先级管理和抢占策略</li>
<li>Chunked prefill支持</li>
</ul>
<p>调度策略:</p>
<pre><code>def _schedule_chunked_prefill(self) -&gt; SchedulerOutputs:
    """使用chunked prefill调度排队请求"""
    # 1. 计算调度预算
    budget = SchedulingBudget(
        token_budget=self.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
        max_num_seqs=self.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs,
    )
    # 2. 预填充阶段调度
    prefills = self._schedule_prefills(budget)

    # 3. 解码阶段调度
    decodes = self._schedule_decodes(budget)

    # 4. 抢占和内存管理
    self._handle_preemption(budget)
</code></pre>
<p>关键数据结构:</p>
<pre><code>@dataclass
class SchedulingBudget:
    token_budget: int                    # token预算
    max_num_seqs: int                    # 最大序列数
    _num_cached_tokens: int = 0          # 缓存token数
    _num_batched_tokens: int = 0        # 批处理token数
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-blockmanager---内存管理器">3 BlockManager - 内存管理器</h3>
<p>位置: vllm/core/block_manager.py</p>
<p>主要职责:</p>
<ul>
<li>实现PagedAttention内存管理</li>
<li>KV缓存的块分配和回收</li>
<li>Copy-on-Write内存共享</li>
<li>前缀缓存管理</li>
</ul>
<p>核心算法:</p>
<pre><code>class SelfAttnBlockSpaceManager(BlockSpaceManager):
    def allocate(self, seq_group: SequenceGroup) -&gt; None:
        """为序列组分配内存块"""
        # 1. 计算需要的块数
        num_required_blocks = self._calculate_required_blocks(seq_group)
    # 2. 检查可用块
    if not self._has_enough_blocks(num_required_blocks):
        raise MemoryError("Insufficient GPU blocks")
        
    # 3. 分配块并建立映射
    block_table = self._allocate_blocks(seq_group, num_required_blocks)
    
    # 4. 更新序列状态
    seq_group.block_tables = block_table
</code></pre>
<p>内存优化策略:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>前缀缓存: 相同前缀的序列共享KV缓存</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Copy-on-Write: 派生序列共享内存块</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>滑动窗口: 限制长序列的内存使用</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>分层内存: GPU/CPU/磁盘三级存储</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="4-attention后端">4 Attention后端</h3>
<p>位置: vllm/attention/backends/</p>
<p>支持的后端:</p>
<ul>
<li>FlashAttention: 最高性能的attention实现</li>
<li>FlashInfer: 高性能推理专用后端</li>
<li>XFormers: 替代性attention实现</li>
<li>Triton: 自定义triton内核</li>
<li>Placeholder: 无attention模型的占位符</li>
</ul>
<p>后端选择逻辑:</p>
<pre><code>def get_attn_backend(head_size: int, dtype: torch.dtype, 
                    kv_cache_dtype: Optional[str], block_size: int,
                    is_attention_free: bool = False) -&gt; type[AttentionBackend]:
    """根据配置选择最优attention后端"""
    # 1. 检查是否为无attention模型
    if is_attention_free:
        return PlaceholderAttentionBackend

    # 2. 检查FlashAttention支持
    if FlashAttentionBackend.is_supported(head_size, dtype, kv_cache_dtype):
        return FlashAttentionBackend

    # 3. 检查其他后端支持
    if FlashInferBackend.is_supported(head_size, dtype, kv_cache_dtype):
        return FlashInferBackend

    # 4. 默认使用Triton后端
    return TritonAttentionBackend
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-worker和modelrunner">5 Worker和ModelRunner</h3>
<p>位置: vllm/worker/</p>
<p>Worker架构:</p>
<pre><code>class Worker(LocalOrDistributedWorkerBase):
    """在GPU上执行(分区)模型的worker类"""
    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, 
                 local_rank: int, rank: int, 
                 distributed_init_method: str):
        # 1. 初始化设备
        self.device = torch.device(f"cuda:{local_rank}")

        # 2. 创建模型运行器
        self.model_runner = ModelRunnerClass(vllm_config)

        # 3. 创建缓存引擎
        self.cache_engine = CacheEngine(vllm_config.cache_config,
                                       vllm_config.model_config,
                                       self.device)

        # 4. 初始化内存
        self._init_memory()
</code></pre>
<p>ModelRunner职责:</p>
<ul>
<li>模型前向传播执行</li>
<li>输入张量准备</li>
<li>Attention元数据管理</li>
<li>CUDA图优化</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="6-executor框架">6 Executor框架</h3>
<p>位置: vllm/executor/</p>
<p>Executor类型:</p>
<ul>
<li>UnipartExecutor: 单GPU执行器</li>
<li>MultiprocessingExecutor: 多进程执行器</li>
<li>RayDistributedExecutor: 基于Ray的分布式执行器</li>
<li>PipelineParallelExecutor: 流水线并行执行器</li>
</ul>
<p>分布式执行:</p>
<pre><code>class RayDistributedExecutor(DistributedExecutorBase):
    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, 
                 placement_group: Optional[PlacementGroup] = None):
        # 1. 初始化Ray集群
        self._init_ray_cluster()
        # 2. 创建远程worker
        self._init_workers(vllm_config, placement_group)

        # 3. 初始化并行状态
        self._initialize_parallel_state(vllm_config.parallel_config)

        # 4. 加载模型
        self._load_model(vllm_config.model_config)
</code></pre>
